environment.profile: bench: release optimization, LTO, one codegen unit, debug symbols
environment.caveat: Desktop, no fixed affinity or frequency. A virtual machine on the same host used about 1.3 cores throughout. No build overlapped a timing run.

pre_engine.note: every change in this release except the cache tag, the engine bump and the bench fix

candidate.note: rounds 1 and 2 of the runtime focused pass ran at 290275b, which differs only in the module-evaluation bench

method.order: v0.5.0, pre_engine and candidate alternated within each round, so drift on the desktop lands on all three
method.flagged: every case the full run marked slower with disjoint 95% intervals and more than 3% was run twice more under default settings, alternating builds
method.estimate: Criterion slope where it fitted one (linear sampling), mean otherwise
